entries.proposition: The two-hybrid bait was not full-length WWOX: it was an isoform carrying the two WW domains and only a truncated SDR, so the screen could not report a full SDR surface.
entries.snippet: containing only the WW1 and WW2 domains, and a truncated SDR domain
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX interacts with MERIT40, first paragraph

entries.proposition: Directness of the WWOX-MERIT40 interaction is asserted from the two-hybrid format and a personal communication, not from a biochemical experiment with purified protein.
entries.snippet: it is very likely that it is a direct interaction
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX interacts with MERIT40, first paragraph

entries.proposition: The binding determinant maps away from the WW domains: the WW1-WW2 fragment does not bind MERIT40 while the WW2-SDR fragment does.
entries.snippet: the N-terminal region of WWOX containing only the WW1 and WW2 domains did not interact with MERIT40, whereas the region composed of the WW2 and SDR domains did
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX interacts with MERIT40, third paragraph

entries.proposition: The authors place the MERIT40-binding determinant in the N-terminal part of the SDR domain, and they state it as a suggestion rather than as a mapped contact.
entries.snippet: the domain of WWOX interacting with MERIT40 is located in the N terminal part of the SDR domain
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX interacts with MERIT40, closing sentence

entries.proposition: The only WWOX point mutant used is a WW1 ligand-binding mutant, not a catalytic-site mutant; it is used to exclude PPxY-mediated binding.
entries.snippet: a mutant form of WWOX harboring a Y33R point mutation in the WW1 domain inhibiting its ability to interact with the PPXY motifs of different proteins
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX interacts with MERIT40, third paragraph

entries.proposition: Abolishing WW1 ligand binding leaves the WWOX-MERIT40 association intact, so this interaction is not a PPxY-WW1 interaction.
entries.snippet: this mutation did not affect the WWOX-MERIT40 association
entries.anchor: Results, WWOX interacts with MERIT40, third paragraph

entries.proposition: The imaging experiment behind the foci conclusion was performed once, on 50 cells per condition, by the authors' own statement.
entries.snippet: 50 cells were counted in each condition, the experiment was done once

entries.proposition: The paper records that the direction of WWOX's effect on homologous recombination is not settled and appears to depend on the cell type used.
entries.snippet: The effect of WWOX on HR seems therefore to depend on the cell type.

entries.proposition: A mechanistic step in the paper's own model is supported only by unpublished data.
entries.snippet: We found that WWOX promotes the formation of BRCA1-A (unpublished data).

entries.proposition: The authors close by calling their own interpretation a hypothesis still to be validated.
entries.snippet: Further analysis have to be perform to validate these hypotheses.

entries.proposition: The endogenous interaction was detected with the group's own antibody on a crude breast-cancer cell extract, which is a pull-down and not an affinity measurement.
entries.snippet: of total proteins were subjected to direct immunoprecipitation with the anti-WWOX antibody produced by Eurogentec
